entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Albino Mamede Cleto was the Roman Catholic bishop of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Coimbra, Portugal, therefore becoming ex officio 29th Count of Arganil. Ordained in 1959, Mamede Cleto was named bishop in 1982 and retired in 2011.
